vehicles.name: Boat-tail roadster (car)
vehicles.note: CAR-1: a 1930s single-seat roadster built in the garage from the Tiger Moth-alike - no wing, a 3.6 L V8, four wheels on wishbones; it DRIVES (the ground vehicle shell, tools/car_sheet.js), it does not fly

vehicles.name: Dune Bug (buggy)
vehicles.note: CAR-2: a dune buggy built from Rufus - its open tube frame is the roll cage, no wing, tail or prop, the Rotax 912 exposed in front, four tundra wheels on wishbones and coil-overs; it DRIVES (tools/car_sheet.js), it does not fly

vehicles.name: Field Wagon Retro (van)
vehicles.note: CAR-3: the airfield's official tow & utility van - a 1940s-style large van from the Cessna 172 card (two pax bays, rear doors, tow hitch, 4WD); the Retro livery: cream over navy, 'Home Field' lettering. Tows the glider and the floatplane trailer

vehicles.name: Field Wagon Alpine (van)
